page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for parallel computing workloads. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 32 dedicated physical cores with 32 vCPUs, operating with one thread per core. The instance is equipped with 240.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 7.5 GB of RAM per core.

For acceleration, the instance integrates four NVIDIA P100 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 64 GB of VRAM. Local storage is bundled with the instance, consisting of 1889 GB of SSD capacity. The network interface provides a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The virtualization layer is managed by the KVM hypervisor.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the inclusion of four dedicated GPUs and local SSD storage within a single instance provides high resource density for legacy GPU workloads, though the older Pascal-architecture P100 GPUs lack modern tensor core advancements. This hardware profile is configured for workloads such as deep learning training, scientific simulations, seismic data processing, and GPU-accelerated database queries.
